findings.description: Add descriptive alt text to the informative images that lack it and empty alt to decorative ones.
Order headings without skipping levels (an h2 followed by an h4 forces assistive technology and machines to guess the structure).
Wrap the primary content of each page in a single <main> landmark so assistive technology can jump to it.
Replace the obvious landmark containers (header, nav, main, footer, aside) with their semantic elements and give remaining containers meaningful class names.
Add the missing response headers at the server or CDN edge; each is a one-line directive that applies site-wide once configured.
Complete the flagged SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical URLs) so search engines and machines index the page with accurate summaries.
